LM15-01.name: Jinrai War Lizard
LM15-01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
While [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, all "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirits you control gain +5000 BP.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [True-Clash] (When Attacks)
The opponent must block with their Spirits/Ultimates if possible.

LM15-02.name: Samurai-War Lizard
LM15-02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Flash - [Awaken]
You can send any number of cores from your Spirits to this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When [Soul Core](Soul Core) is sent to this Spirit via [Awaken], once per turn, refresh all your "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirits.

LM15-03.name: The SengokuSmallDragon Soul War Lizard
LM15-03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Lord"/"Vassal" family Spirits gain an extra Red symbol.

[LV2][LV3] [Consecutive Blade] (When Attacks)
By sending [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, the opponent must block with two Spirits/Ultimates if possible, and they simultaneously battle this Spirit.
